title: Sales Consultant

about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a company specialising in premium powersports watercraft and luxury water toys, for a motivated and commercially driven Sales Consultant to join its showroom team in Marsa, Malta.

You will represent an exclusive portfolio of internationally recognised brands, including Sea-Doo, Can-Am, Flite Boards and Seabob, selling jet skis, electric surfboards and luxury superyacht water toys to a discerning clientele. The role covers the full sale: welcoming showroom visitors, understanding what each customer needs, presenting product features and technical specifications, supporting demonstrations, and following up enquiries until they convert.

This full-time, on-site position suits a confident sales professional with previous sales experience, fluent Maltese and English, and a genuine interest in luxury products and the powersports industry. The package is a competitive base salary plus commission.
responsibilities: Welcome and engage with customers visiting the showroom, providing a high-quality sales experience
Promote and sell premium powersports products, including jet skis, electric surfboards and luxury superyacht water toys

Manage sales enquiries, follow up with prospective customers and convert leads into sales
Present product features, benefits and technical specifications to potential buyers
Support product demonstrations and allow customers to experience selected demo products
Achieve individual sales targets and contribute to the overall performance of the showroom
